module: Editor API for managing engine datablocks (shared data objects: sounds, particles, physical materials, etc.). initialize(editor) adds the creation, lookup, save and delete functions to the editor object; persistence goes through a PersistenceManager named dataBlockPersistMan. Default file: art/datablocks/managedDatablocks.json.
notes: Bug: initialize assigns editor.addDataBlockToFile = addDataBlockToFile, but the local function is named addDatablockToFile (different casing). editor.addDataBlockToFile is therefore nil.
createDataBlock returns the object ID (getID()), not the object.

initialize.desc: Creates the dataBlockPersistMan PersistenceManager if it does not exist and installs the functions on the editor object.

editor.desc: Functions added to the editor object by initialize.

createDataBlock.desc: Creates a datablock of the given type, optionally copies the fields of an existing one, registers it, names it, adds it to the dataBlockGroup group and to the datablock set, then marks it as modified for the file.

copyFrom.desc: Name of a datablock to copy fields from (ignored if nil or empty)

saveDirtyDataBlock.desc: Saves the datablock if it is modified.

removeDataBlockFromFile.desc: Removes the datablock from the set and, if it has a file name, deletes it from its file.

saveDataBlockToFile.desc: Associates the datablock with a file (by default its current file) then saves it immediately.

isDataBlockDirty.desc: Returns whether the datablock has been modified.

setDataBlockDirty.desc: Marks the datablock as modified (file = its file, otherwise the default file).

getDataBlocks.desc: Returns the set of all datablocks (Sim.getDataBlockSet()).

findDataBlock.desc: Looks up a datablock by name by iterating over the set.
